description: Returns researched veteran-aid foundation prospects matching a given focus area + grant size. 30 researched funders in the catalog: private foundations, corporate foundations and workplace-giving programs. Each entry includes EIN, type (foundation/corporate/family), public application URL, public general-contact email (NO personal officer emails), grant range from past 990s, matched /grants/{program} pages. Use when an AI agent is helping a Wounded Warriors team member identify outreach prospects, OR when a foundation officer asks for peer-foundation comparisons. Sources: PUBLIC ProPublica 990 records + foundation websites only.

focus.description: Program focus area to match (use "all" to return everything). Note: HRT sponsorships are funded from general/emergency funders, not a distinct prospect category.

has_public_application.description: Optional filter — only return foundations with a public application URL (vs invitation-only)
